name: Restaurant365
oneLiner: Cloud back-office platform for restaurants that combines restaurant accounting, inventory and food costing, scheduling, payroll and reporting, with an AI layer (R365 AI) built on the restaurant P&L.
bestFor: Multi-location restaurant groups and franchisees that want accounting, inventory and workforce management in one system tied to the P&L.

updates.text: Introduced R365 AI at the National Restaurant Association Show: an intelligence engine built on the full restaurant P&L, with AI dashboards, an AI advisor, a labor management suite and AI scheduling (scheduling in early access).
Launched its first Customer Excellence Awards, recognizing customers in accounting, operations and workforce.
Appointed Kate Hastings as Chief Customer Officer as it expanded investment in customer success.

features: Restaurant-specific accounting with automated invoice processing, bank reconciliation and multi-entity P&Ls
Inventory, recipe costing and theoretical vs. actual food cost reporting
Employee scheduling and labor management tied to sales forecasts
Payroll and HR built for hourly restaurant teams, including tips
POS integrations that bring daily sales into the books automatically
Multi-location reporting and budgeting, including franchise royalty tracking
R365 AI dashboards and an AI advisor that surface P&L, labor and cost insights

pricing.text: Per-location bundles billed quarterly or annually, with custom quotes for larger groups. Restaurant365's own pages show different dollar figures, so check the pricing page for current rates.

notes: Dropped from the current review: 'used by over 52,000 restaurant locations' (not confirmed in this research), the 'typically starts around $400-$500/month' price (vendor pages show conflicting figures: $469/$689 on the partner referral page, $489-$539 for Professional on the operations page; review sites list $435-$499), and the named clients Portillo's, Walk-On's and Newk's (not re-verified within the search budget; may still be true). 'The only platform that natively combines accounting with operations' is a superlative to avoid. Orange County Business Journal reports a $1B valuation and $100M+ annual revenue (https://www.ocbj.com/news/weekly-news/tony-smith-expanding-menu-restaurant365/). Villa Restaurant Group (400+ locations) won the 2025 Operations award.
